verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README says the open-source Python library lets you automate the web "with any LLM" (browser-use-gh-3). A community user independently reports it supports more models than alternatives and ran it with Gemini (browser-use-comm-1), which corroborates the model-agnostic claim. The Cloud pricing page also offers a choice among several models (browser-use-docs-35). missing for 10: first-party docs listing the supported providers and how to configure your own provider or API keys, and evidence of whether the Cloud agent accepts a bring-your-own model rather than only a curated list.
